output.summary: The FY2026 record is mostly a commodity price rally. Bushels were flat and peers grew similarly. Revenue growth ranks 8th of 23 and net savings growth 10th, with no peer running a comparable program. The cost-per-bushel gain comes from deferred maintenance, and the deferred work-order backlog tripled. The insurer found critical dust and bearing-monitoring hazards at Harlan Junction. Near-miss follow-up was skipped, but staff do report, so the problem is a lack of response and not fear. Drying and grading knowledge sits with one retiring superintendent, and the expansion case assumes high prices and unsourced volume. Fix the hazards, start succession, and rebuild the financial case before voting.
